title: Small dataset, TRIAD against the non-agentic baselines
hypothesis: P finishes end to end with no manual step except approval; agent overhead dominates P's time at this size.
conclusion: configuration P did not complete: stopped at ESCALATED: cleaning failed
limitations: P did not reach selection, so there is no shared split for the baselines to use and no like-for-like quality comparison. The baselines were not run: splitting them differently from P would make the comparison meaningless.
